City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 14, 2018 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL -- COUNCIL MEMBER BOERNER HORVATH WILL BE PARTICIPATING VIA TELECONFERENCE FROM THE LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES OFFICES LOCATED AT 1400 K STREET, 4TH FLOOR, REDWOOD ROOM, SACRAMENTO, CA 95814 (ANY QUESTIONS REGARDING BUILDING ACCESS, CONTACT DAN CARRIGG, DEPUTY EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR/LEGISLATIVE DIRECTOR, LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES AT 916-835-8222)
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the October 17, 2018 Regular Meeting and October 24, 2018 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2018-11-14 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2018-11-14 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Youth Commission Work Plan Outcomes for FY 2017-18 and Proposed Work Plan for FY 2018-19. Contact Person: Recreation Supervisor Rundle
1) Receive report regarding the FY 2017-18 Youth Commission Work Plan; and 2) Approve the proposed FY 2018-2019 Youth Commission Work Plan.
2018-11-14 Item 08C Youth Commission Work Plan
8D.
Contract Amendments for Construction Management and Inspection Services. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
1) Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute amendments to the Kleinfelder Construction Services, Inc. (Kleinfelder) and Michael Baker International, Inc. (MBI) agreements, for as-needed construction management and inspections, in additional amounts of $300,000 each, for total contracts not exceeding $500,000 each; and 2) Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute amendments to the Dudek Engineering (Dudek) agreement for as-needed construction management and inspections, in an additional amount of $100,000, for a total contract not exceeding $300,000.
2018-11-14 Item 08D Amendment to Contracts for Construction Management and Inspection Services
8E.
First Amendment to Easement Agreement with North County Transit District for the Cardiff Coastal Rail Trail. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the First Amendment to the Easement Agreement with North County Transit District (NCTD) for construction and maintenance of the Cardiff Coastal Rail Trail improvements in the rail right-of-way (in substantial form).
2018-11-14 Item 08E First Amendment to Easement Agreement to Coastal Rail Trail
8F.
Construction Contract for the FY 2017-18 Citywide Storm Drain Rehabilitation Project, (CD05E). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Widelski
1) Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to execute a contract in consultation with the City Attorney, and any necessary amendments and time extensions with Downstream Services in the amount of $249,061 plus 15% contingencies to construct the FY 2017-18 Citywide Storm Drain Rehabilitation Project, for a total contract not to exceed amount of $286,420; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to execute a contract in consultation with the City Attorney, and any necessary amendments and time extensions with Dudek in the amount of $66,663 plus 15% contingencies for construction management of the FY 2017-18 Citywide Storm Drain Rehabilitation Project, for a total contract not to exceed amount of $76,663.
2018-11-14 Item 08F Citywide Storm Drain Rehabilitation Project
8G.
Notice of Completion for the Santa Fe Drive North Sidewalk Improvements, a HSIP project (CS07B and HSIP 5446-018). Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Kellar
1) Accept the public improvements as complete; 2) Authorize release of the performance bond and initiate the warranty bond; and 3) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion
2018-11-14 Item 08G Notice of Completion Santa Fe Drive North Sidewalk
8H.
Cancelation of the December 19, 2018 Regular City Council meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Council approve canceling the December 19, 2018 Regular City Council meeting.
2018-11-14 Item 08H Cancelation of December 19 Regular Meeting
8I.
Public hearing and consideration of Resolution 2018-93 Regarding Findings Related to the Unexpended Fund Balance for Impact/Mitigation fees collected prior to June 30, 2013 and acceptance of the Annual Report of Development Impact/Mitigation Fees for Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2018 as required by the California Mitigation Fee Act. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup and Financial Analyst Rau
Adopt Resolution 2018-93 Regarding Findings Related to the Unexpended Fund Balance for fees collected prior to June 30, 2013 and accept the Annual Report of Development Impact/Mitigation Fees for Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2018.
2018-11-14 Item 08I Public Hearing and Consideration of Resolution 2018-93 and 5-Year Report for Mitigation Impact Fees
8J.
Capital Project and Grants Update - Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Receive the report on the status of Capital Improvement and Traffic Engineering projects and grants.
2018-11-14 Item 08J Mobility Projects and Grants Update
8K.
Acceptance of Two Easements over the San Dieguito Water District Property Located at 601 Santa Fe Drive. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Kellar
Authorize the Development Services Department Director to accept the pedestrian, drainage, and general utility easement and the wall footing easement over 601 Santa Fe Drive and to convey fair market value or equivalent thereof to the San Dieguito Water District for such easements rights.
2018-11-14 Item 08K SDWD Easements
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing regarding the introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2018-16, to adopt modifications suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2018-05, which amended the General Plan, North 101 Corridor Specific Plan, and the Local Coastal Plan to clarify provisions for roadway improvements on North Coast Highway 101. CASE NO: 10-036 GPA/SPA/LCPA/EIR. Contact Person: Associate Planner Plagemann
1) Conduct the public hearing; and 2) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2018-16 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Modifications Suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2018-05, which Adopted Amendments to the Local Coastal Plan, North 101 Corridor Specific Plan and the General Plan to clarify provisions for roadway improvements on North Coast Highway 101.”
2018-11-14 Item 10A Public Hearing Streetscape
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council Initiated Item from Mayor Blakespear and Council Member Kranz regarding Council consideration of joining the “Vision Zero” network.
2018-11-14 Item 12A Council Initiated Item from Mayor Blakespear and Council Member Kranz - Regarding Consideration of Joining the Vision Zero Network
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING POSSIBLE FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2018-11-14 Item 15 Possible Future Agenda Items
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON NOVEMBER 28, 2018
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
